title: Long Amplify builds die at 1 hour: ExpiredToken in the deploy watcher and in ampx pipeline-deploy
description:
Found on the Humorus 5.108.0 to 5.114.0 move (Amplify job 6, 2026-11-15). One cause, two failures: AWS credentials last one hour.
1) Reusable workflow app-shell-deploy.yml: the step that polls the Amplify job (aws amplify get-job) failed with ExpiredTokenException at about 1 hour while the Amplify job kept running. The OIDC role session is capped at 1 hour, so the poll loop must re-assume the role (re-run configure-aws-credentials) before expiry, or the role's session duration must be raised through the account IaC.
2) Inside the Amplify build, ampx pipeline-deploy died with ExpiredToken at 1 hour 5 minutes while CloudFormation was still applying Item index additions; the stacks kept updating server side. The 120 minute build timeout cannot help while the build role session is 1 hour. Fix properly: papyrus-infra backend-deploy must survive credential expiry (refresh credentials, or split the deploy so each step stays under an hour), and the app-shell stack should raise the Amplify service role maximum session duration if that is the cap. Also order or batch index additions so a normal upgrade finishes well under an hour.
